title: Wheelr Service Documentation

documentation.title: Ready-made wheel templates (20, each with its own page)
A single ready-made wheel, spinnable without an account
Full site content in one file (25 pages)

notes: Every public page is prerendered to static HTML at build time, so agents that do not execute JavaScript get the full content directly from the HTML. /llms-full.txt carries the same content in one response, and any page also answers `Accept: text/markdown` with its markdown version. Shared wheels under /{id} are the one exception: they are user content, rendered client-side and marked noindex.
